physical_subject: How many shares can four identical counters make among three labeled jars?
relationship: Nonnegative allocations of four identical objects to three labeled groups correspond bijectively to six-position rows with two separators, giving15. Requiring each group nonempty leaves3.
operation: Transform persistent counters into a stars-and-bars row; empty jars arise from adjacent or edge dividers; changing the minimum changes the count.
